headline: 10+ detained in Chittagong for Awami League procession
summary: Police intercepted a group of youths who arrived in a microbus to hold a rally with banners of the banned party.
details: At least 10 to 12 people were detained by police in the CRB area of Chittagong on Friday afternoon after attempting to hold a procession with banners of the banned Awami League.
The group arrived in a microbus near the Chest Disease Hospital in the CRB area shortly after Friday's Jummah prayers and began their rally.
A police patrol team stationed nearby intervened immediately, causing the procession to scatter and leading to the arrests.
Police have also seized the microbus used by the group to reach the location.
Preliminary investigations suggest that those detained are followers of Mohibul Hassan Chowdhury, the former Education Minister of the ousted Awami League government.
Kotwali Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Zahedul Kabir confirmed the arrests, stating that the identities of the detainees are being verified before legal action is taken.
caption:
10+ people detained in Chittagong after attempting to hold a banned party rally.

At least 10 to 12 people were detained by police in the CRB area of Chittagong on Friday afternoon after attempting to hold a procession with banners of the banned Awami League.

The group arrived in a microbus near the Chest Disease Hospital in the CRB area shortly after Friday's Jummah prayers and began their rally.

A police patrol team stationed nearby intervened immediately, causing the procession to scatter and leading to the arrests.

Police have also seized the microbus used by the group to reach the location.

Preliminary investigations suggest that those detained are followers of Mohibul Hassan Chowdhury, the former Education Minister of the ousted Awami League government.

Kotwali Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Zahedul Kabir confirmed the arrests, stating that the identities of the detainees are being verified before legal action is taken.

headline: 11 crude bombs recovered after 2 injured in Chapainawabganj explosions
summary: The blasts occurred amid ongoing tension between two groups over a mosque dispute in the Maharajpur union area.
details: Two people were injured in crude bomb explosions in the Maharajpur union of Chapainawabganj today. Police subsequently recovered 11 unexploded crude bombs from the scene.
The explosions took place in two separate areas; one blast occurred in Sheikpara around 5:30 am, and two more occurred in Kabirajpara around 9:30 am.
The injured have been identified as 32-year-old Md Sumon and 18-year-old Md Hamid. According to police, the violence stems from a dispute over a mosque.
Tension had been prevailing for several days between followers of Md Abdul Oudud Mohari and Jalal Uddin. The two groups had previously engaged in an altercation on Thursday afternoon.
Police have submerged the recovered explosives in water for safety. Investigations are ongoing to identify those involved and file a formal case.
caption:
11 unexploded crude bombs recovered after explosions leave two injured in Chapainawabganj.

The injured have been identified as 32-year-old Md Sumon and 18-year-old Md Hamid. According to police, the violence stems from a dispute over a mosque.

Tension had been prevailing for several days between followers of Md Abdul Oudud Mohari and Jalal Uddin. The two groups had previously engaged in an altercation on Thursday afternoon.

Police have submerged the recovered explosives in water for safety. Investigations are ongoing to identify those involved and file a formal case.
